requirements.text: The complete wheel is no more than 38.0 mm diameter and 18.0 mm high including the 2 mm raised front hub.
The wheel has six equally spaced shallow scallops, at least 33 mm minimum grip diameter, nominal 1.0 mm exposed-edge rounds and subtle raised grip dots that do not form glove catches.
The concentric blind D socket is 10.0 mm deep and derives from a 6.00 mm round boundary and 5.20 mm across-flat shaft with 0.20 mm radial and 0.20 mm flat clearance.
At least 3.0 mm material remains above the blind socket and no set screw, insert, taper or keyway is added.
Source and repaired printable meshes are distinct, correspond to the same approved geometry, and the final slice package binds to the repaired mesh revision.
The final package uses installed matching P1S 0.4 mm PETG profiles, 0.20 mm layers, four perimeters and 35% infill; any PLA geometry prototype is explicitly labeled and cannot satisfy PETG.
Orientation and support decisions protect the upward-facing blind socket where feasible, retain an actual support/slicing preview, and identify any required support.
Non-mating prototype dimensions use the proposed ±0.25 mm tolerance while D-socket design values remain separate from future measured fit values.
The output set contains source mesh, repaired printable mesh, support/slicing preview, final P1S PETG package and a digest-bound local simulator transfer receipt.
The result does not claim strength, fit, accuracy, standards compliance or successful printing and does not use printer credentials, transfer to a physical printer or start a print.
